elements.name: method-steps
elements.text:
Initialize x⁰, bounds B⁰, α, ρ, μ

1. Linearize / form the LALM subproblem
2. Encode the bounded subproblem on a lattice
3. Solve with QHD-SB; retain 1 or K beams
4. Refine each candidate continuously
5. Rank by feasibility first, objective second
6. Update μ, ρ, α and shrink bounds
7. Stop on residual, step, or iteration limits
